text: U.S. stock indices are trading higher today, with the S&P 500, Dow Jones, and Nasdaq Composite all posting gains as investors engage in bargain hunting and find relief in a temporary stabilization of Treasury yields following three sessions of selling. Market sentiment remains cautious due to ongoing geopolitical tensions between the U.S. and Iran—which have kept oil prices elevated—and concerns over potential Federal Reserve rate hikes following a softer-than-expected ADP private payrolls report. While AI-linked shares and strong earnings from companies like Dell are providing support, sectors such as technology, real estate, and utilities have faced relative pressure during the session.
